python3 -c "
import zipfile, re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

ns = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))

data = {}
for row in root.findall('.//m:row', ns):
    for c in row.findall('m:c', ns):
        ref, t = c.get('r'), c.get('t')
        v = c.find('m:v', ns)
        f = c.find('m:f', ns)
        isel = c.find('m:is', ns)
        if v is not None: val = v.text
        elif isel is not None: val = ''.join(x.text or '' for x in isel.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
        else: val = None
        data[ref] = (val, f.text if f is not None else None)

expenses = [int(data[r][0]) for r in ('C11','C12','C13','C14','C15','C16','C17','C18','C19','C20','C21','C22')]
cats = {}
for r, cat in [('C11','Housing'),('C12','Housing'),('C13','Housing'),('C14','Transportation'),('C15','Transportation'),('C16','Transportation'),('C17','Food'),('C18','Food'),('C19','Entertainment'),('C20','Entertainment'),('C21','Savings'),('C22','Savings')]:
    cats[cat] = cats.get(cat, 0) + int(data[r][0])

income = sum(int(data[r][0]) for r in ('B4','B5','B6','B7'))
print('Formulas after update:')
print('  B8 :', data['B8'][1], '-> cached', data['B8'][0])
print('  C23:', data['C23'][1], '-> cached', data['C23'][0])
print('  B25:', data['B25'][1], '-> cached', data['B25'][0])
print()
print('Income total        :', income)
print('Expenses grand total:', sum(expenses))
print('Per-category:')
for k, v in cats.items():
    print(f'  {k:15s} {v}')
print('Balance (income - total expenses):', income - sum(expenses))
print()
print('Check: cached C23 == sum of C11:C22:', int(data['C23'][0]) == sum(expenses))
print('Check: cached B25 == B8 - C23     :', int(data['B25'][0]) == income - sum(expenses))
"
